NG-OFFS-007.question: what is the best treatmemt for a mgraine

payload.answer:
- In a grievance debate on 23 March 1994, Liberal senator Michael Ronaldson said the drug Imigran, also called Sumatriptan, “provides extraordinary relief for migraine sufferers” but was not available at a reasonable price.
- Labor's Dominic John Foreman asked in question time on 26 May 1993 whether the Minister for Health was aware of sumitriptan for treating migraine and when sufferers could get it at a sensible price.
- On 10 June 2020 Labor's Chris Bowen said a new type of migraine medicine had let a chronic migraine sufferer return to work, while Emgality and AJOVY had been recommended for the PBS but not yet listed.
- Labor's Amanda Rishworth told the House on 15 March 2021 that although the advisory committee recommended listing Emgality on the PBS in 2019, the government had failed to act for chronic migraine sufferers like Tina of Morphett Vale.
- On 18 September 2019 Labor's Maria Vamvakinou described Sunshine Hospital neurology chief Professor Tissa Wijeratne's holistic approach to brain health and his aim of a national migraine research centre in Melbourne's west.
- Labor's Steve Georganas said on 28 September 2022 that a medicines bill would cut costs for around 20,000 migraine sufferers among other patients.
